data.native_gpu_runtime.py:
"""Disabled, experimental native cgroup GPU startup contract (no MIG/HAMi/MPS).

Only trusted service code may supply the binding, profile and settings. The
detached intent must be registered with the cap authority; Pod annotations are
comparison hints, never a source of authorization. This module deliberately
does not change Policy, Hub, Argo, JobSet, grants or production qualification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections.abc import Mapping
import copy
from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import time
from typing import Any
import uuid


PROTOCOL = 'cps-native-gpu/v1'
GATE_NAME = 'cps-native-cap-gate'
SPEC_ANNOTATION = 'cps.compute/native-spec-sha256'
RECEIPTS = '/run/cps-native-gpu/receipts'
AUTHORITY = '/run/cps-native-gpu/authority'
DRIVER_METADATA = '/run/cps-native-gpu/driver'
_NAME = re.compile(r'[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\Z')
_DIGEST = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}\Z')
_IMAGE = re.compile(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}\Z')
_CONTROL_ENV = ('CUDA_', 'NVIDIA_', 'GPU_', 'VGPU_', 'HAMI_', 'MPS_', 'LD_')
_INTENT_KEYS = {'namespace', 'name', 'pod_uid', 'node', 'node_uid', 'spec_sha256',
                'gpu_uuid', 'cap_mib', 'policy_hash'}
_IDENTITY_KEYS = {'pod_uid', 'spec_sha256', 'node_uid', 'gpu_uuid', 'container_id',
    'host_pid', 'pid_start_ticks', 'boot_id', 'cgroup_relative', 'cgroup_path',
    'cgroup_device', 'cgroup_inode', 'driver_generation'}
_SECURITY = {'runAsNonRoot': True, 'runAsUser': 1000, 'runAsGroup': 100,
    'allowPrivilegeEscalation': False, 'readOnlyRootFilesystem': True,
    'capabilities': {'drop': ['ALL']}, 'seccompProfile': {'type': 'RuntimeDefault'}}
_PRIVATE_VOLUMES = {
    'cps-native-receipts': (RECEIPTS, RECEIPTS),
    'cps-native-authority': (AUTHORITY, AUTHORITY),
    'cps-native-driver-metadata': ('/sys/module', DRIVER_METADATA),
}


def _uuid(value: Any) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError('Canonical UUID required')
    try:
        parsed = uuid.UUID(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError('Canonical UUID required') from None
    if str(parsed) != value:
        raise ValueError('Canonical UUID required')


def _name(value: Any) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _NAME.fullmatch(value):
        raise ValueError('Canonical Kubernetes identifier required')


def _positive(value: Any) -> None:
    if type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Positive integer required')


def _gpu(value: Any) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.startswith('GPU-'):
        raise ValueError('Bound full GPU UUID required')
    _uuid(value[4:])


def _closed(value: Any, keys: set[str], description: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != keys:
        raise ValueError('Closed ' + description + ' schema required')


def _absolute(value: Any) -> None:
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or not value.startswith('/') or len(value) > 4096
            or '\x00' in value or '\\' in value
            or str(PurePosixPath(value)) != value or '..' in PurePosixPath(value).parts):
        raise ValueError('Canonical absolute path required')


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeGpuRuntimeSettings:
    """Deployment-owned images; enabled=False and qualified=False are defaults."""

    gate_image: str
    approved_gate_images: frozenset[str]
    approved_workload_images: frozenset[str]
    approved_pvc_claims: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
    enabled: bool = False
    qualified: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if type(self.enabled) is not bool or self.qualified is not False:
            raise ValueError('Native runtime remains unqualified')
        for allowlist in (self.approved_gate_images, self.approved_workload_images):
            if (not isinstance(allowlist, frozenset) or not allowlist
                    or any(not isinstance(i, str) or not _IMAGE.fullmatch(i) for i in allowlist)):
                raise ValueError('Pinned operator image allowlist required')
        if self.gate_image not in self.approved_gate_images:
            raise ValueError('Approved immutable gate image required')
        if not isinstance(self.approved_pvc_claims, frozenset):
            raise ValueError('Operator PVC allowlist required')
        for claim in self.approved_pvc_claims:
            _name(claim)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeGpuBinding:
    """Authority-supplied fixed placement; never constructed from browser data."""

    namespace: str
    name: str
    node: str
    node_uid: str
    gpu_uuid: str
    profile: str
    policy_hash: str

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in (self.namespace, self.name, self.node, self.profile):
            _name(name)
        _uuid(self.node_uid)
        _gpu(self.gpu_uuid)
        if not isinstance(self.policy_hash, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', self.policy_hash):
            raise ValueError('Version-bound policy hash required')


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativePodContract:
    pod: dict[str, Any]
    binding: NativeGpuBinding
    cap_mib: int
    spec_sha256: str
    qualification: str = 'pilot-unqualified'

    def intent_for_pod_uid(self, pod_uid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Finish the detached authority record using the API-created Pod UID."""
        _uuid(pod_uid)
        b = self.binding
        return {'namespace': b.namespace, 'name': b.name, 'pod_uid': pod_uid,
            'node': b.node, 'node_uid': b.node_uid, 'gpu_uuid': b.gpu_uuid,
            'cap_mib': self.cap_mib, 'policy_hash': b.policy_hash,
            'spec_sha256': self.spec_sha256}


def native_spec_sha256(pod: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Hash the exact final Pod spec, including every init/sidecar/main container.

    Metadata is excluded to avoid a self-reference through the spec-hash hint.
    Kubernetes defaulting or an injector changes this hash: trusted adapters
    must register the final admitted spec, never weaken comparison to selected
    fields. The detached intent, not an annotation, is authoritative.
    """
    if not isinstance(pod, Mapping) or not isinstance(pod.get('spec'), Mapping):
        raise ValueError('Final Pod spec required')
    try:
        encoded = json.dumps(pod['spec'], sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
                             ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode()
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        raise ValueError('JSON-compatible final Pod spec required') from None
    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def _without_reviewed_api_defaults(spec: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Only remove known harmless API defaults; never ignore executable deltas."""
    result = copy.deepcopy(dict(spec))
    # Kubernetes serializes the deprecated alias as well as the canonical
    # account name. Only identical aliases are semantically redundant.
    if ('serviceAccount' in result
            and result['serviceAccount'] == result.get('serviceAccountName')):
        del result['serviceAccount']
    pod_defaults = {'dnsPolicy': 'ClusterFirst', 'schedulerName': 'default-scheduler',
        'serviceAccountName': 'default', 'terminationGracePeriodSeconds': 30,
        'restartPolicy': 'Always', 'preemptionPolicy': 'PreemptLowerPriority',
        'priority': 0, 'hostNetwork': False, 'hostPID': False, 'hostIPC': False}
    for name, value in pod_defaults.items():
        if name in result and result[name] == value:
            del result[name]
    tolerations = [
        {'key': 'node.kubernetes.io/not-ready', 'operator': 'Exists',
         'effect': 'NoExecute', 'tolerationSeconds': 300},
        {'key': 'node.kubernetes.io/unreachable', 'operator': 'Exists',
         'effect': 'NoExecute', 'tolerationSeconds': 300}]
    if result.get('tolerations') in (tolerations, list(reversed(tolerations))):
        del result['tolerations']
    for container in [*result.get('initContainers', []), *result.get('containers', [])]:
        defaults = {'imagePullPolicy': 'IfNotPresent',
            'terminationMessagePath': '/dev/termination-log', 'terminationMessagePolicy': 'File'}
        for name, value in defaults.items():
            if container.get(name) == value:
                del container[name]
        if container.get('resources') == {}:
            del container['resources']
        resources = container.get('resources', {})
        if 'requests' in resources and resources['requests'] == resources.get('limits'):
            del resources['requests']
        for entry in container.get('env', []):
            # EnvVar.value uses omitempty: a missing constant value is exactly
            # the empty string. A valueFrom entry is never normalized this way.
            if entry.get('value') == '' and 'valueFrom' not in entry:
                del entry['value']
            field_ref = entry.get('valueFrom', {}).get('fieldRef', {})
            if field_ref.get('apiVersion') == 'v1':
                del field_ref['apiVersion']
        for port in container.get('ports', []):
            if port.get('protocol') == 'TCP':
                del port['protocol']
    for volume in result.get('volumes', []):
        claim = volume.get('persistentVolumeClaim', {})
        if claim.get('readOnly') is False:
            del claim['readOnly']
    return result


def finalize_native_admitted_pod(contract: NativePodContract,
                                dryrun_pod: Mapping[str, Any]) -> NativePodContract:
    """Pin reviewed API defaults BEFORE create, while gate env is unsnapshotted.

    The trusted caller obtains an API server dry-run for the compiled Pod. Any
    new executable, device, security, volume, credential or nondefault resource
    mutation is rejected. Create the returned Pod, then compare the actual API
    UID and complete spec to its detached intent before assigning/sealing a cap.
    Do not call this on an already-created Pod or patch a hash after gate start.
    """
    if (not isinstance(contract, NativePodContract)
            or native_spec_sha256(contract.pod) != contract.spec_sha256
            or not isinstance(dryrun_pod, Mapping)
            or dryrun_pod.get('apiVersion') != 'v1' or dryrun_pod.get('kind') != 'Pod'
            or dryrun_pod.get('metadata', {}).get('name') != contract.binding.name
            or dryrun_pod.get('metadata', {}).get('namespace') != contract.binding.namespace
            or not isinstance(dryrun_pod.get('spec'), Mapping)):
        raise ValueError('Trusted native contract and API dry-run admission required')
    try:
        expected = _without_reviewed_api_defaults(contract.pod['spec'])
        admitted = _without_reviewed_api_defaults(dryrun_pod['spec'])
    except (TypeError, AttributeError, KeyError):
        raise ValueError('Malformed native API admission') from None
    if expected != admitted:
        raise ValueError('Unreviewed executable/device/security change during native admission')
    final = copy.deepcopy(contract.pod)
    final['spec'] = copy.deepcopy(dryrun_pod['spec'])
    digest = native_spec_sha256(final)
    final['metadata']['annotations'][SPEC_ANNOTATION] = digest
    return NativePodContract(final, contract.binding, contract.cap_mib, digest)


def _validate_intent(intent: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    _closed(intent, _INTENT_KEYS, 'native intent')
    for key in ('namespace', 'name', 'node'):
        _name(intent[key])
    for key in ('pod_uid', 'node_uid'):
        _uuid(intent[key])
    _gpu(intent['gpu_uuid'])
    if type(intent['cap_mib']) is not int or intent['cap_mib'] not in (5120, 10240, 20480):
        raise ValueError('Fixed native profile cap required')
    if not isinstance(intent['spec_sha256'], str) or not _DIGEST.fullmatch(intent['spec_sha256']):
        raise ValueError('Native spec hash required')
    if not isinstance(intent['policy_hash'], str) or not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', intent['policy_hash']):
        raise ValueError('Native policy hash required')


def validate_native_pod_intent(pod: Mapping[str, Any], intent: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Check an observed Pod against a separately registered trusted intent."""
    _validate_intent(intent)
    metadata = pod.get('metadata', {})
    if (metadata.get('name') != intent['name'] or metadata.get('namespace') != intent['namespace']
            or metadata.get('uid') != intent['pod_uid']
            or pod.get('spec', {}).get('nodeName') != intent['node']
            or metadata.get('annotations', {}).get(SPEC_ANNOTATION) != intent['spec_sha256']
            or native_spec_sha256(pod) != intent['spec_sha256']):
        raise ValueError('Pod identity or final spec disagrees with trusted intent')


def _user_container(container: Any, settings: NativeGpuRuntimeSettings,
                    volumes: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    allowed = {'name', 'image', 'imagePullPolicy', 'command', 'args', 'env', 'resources',
               'volumeMounts', 'securityContext', 'ports', 'workingDir'}
    if not isinstance(container, Mapping) or set(container) - allowed:
        raise ValueError('Closed user container schema required; native sidecars need qualification')
    result = copy.deepcopy(dict(container))
    _name(result.get('name'))
    if result['name'].startswith('cps-native-') or result.get('image') not in settings.approved_workload_images:
        raise ValueError('Reserved gate name or unapproved workload image')
    supplied = result.get('securityContext', {})
    if not isinstance(supplied, Mapping) or any(k not in _SECURITY or v != _SECURITY[k] for k, v in supplied.items()):
        raise ValueError('Workload security override forbidden')
    result['securityContext'] = copy.deepcopy(_SECURITY)
    environment = result.get('env', [])
    if not isinstance(environment, list):
        raise ValueError('Explicit workload environment required')
    seen = set()
    for entry in environment:
        _closed(entry, {'name', 'value'}, 'workload environment')
        name, value = entry['name'], entry['value']
        if (not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', name)
                or name in seen or name.upper().startswith(_CONTROL_ENV)
                or not isinstance(value, str) or '\x00' in value):
            raise ValueError('GPU, HAMi, MPS or loader control environment forbidden')
        seen.add(name)
    resources = result.get('resources', {})
    if not isinstance(resources, Mapping) or set(resources) - {'requests', 'limits'}:
        raise ValueError('Only fixed CPU/memory workload resources permitted')
    for amounts in resources.values():
        if not isinstance(amounts, Mapping) or set(amounts) - {'cpu', 'memory'}:
            raise ValueError('GPU resource/device injection belongs to trusted binding authority')
        if any(not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip() for v in amounts.values()):
            raise ValueError('Canonical fixed resource strings required')
    mounts = result.get('volumeMounts', [])
    if not isinstance(mounts, list):
        raise ValueError('Approved readonly workload mounts required')
    paths = set()
    for mount in mounts:
        if not isinstance(mount, Mapping) or set(mount) - {'name', 'mountPath', 'readOnly', 'subPath'}:
            raise ValueError('Closed workload mount schema required')
        name, path = mount.get('name'), mount.get('mountPath')
        _absolute(path)
        if (name not in volumes or name in _PRIVATE_VOLUMES or path in paths
                or any(path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix + '/')
                       for prefix in ('/run', '/sys', '/proc', '/dev', '/mps'))
                or mount.get('readOnly') is not True):
            raise ValueError('Only approved readonly data mounts permitted')
        if 'subPath' in mount:
            subpath = mount['subPath']
            if (not isinstance(subpath, str) or not subpath or subpath.startswith('/')
                    or str(PurePosixPath(subpath)) != subpath
                    or '..' in PurePosixPath(subpath).parts or '\x00' in subpath or '\\' in subpath):
                raise ValueError('Canonical data subpath required')
        paths.add(path)
    return result


def compile_native_gpu_pod(pod: Mapping[str, Any], profile: Mapping[str, Any], *,
                          binding: NativeGpuBinding, settings: NativeGpuRuntimeSettings,
                          qualification_pilot: bool = False) -> NativePodContract:
    """Compile a bounded pilot only; authorize profiles/members before calling.

    The device authority must inject an exact UUID binding and register the
    final admitted spec before sealing. User annotations, extended resources,
    CDI declarations and environment cannot choose a GPU or a cap. No native
    failure falls back to HAMi or MPS.
    """
    if not isinstance(settings, NativeGpuRuntimeSettings) or not settings.enabled:
        raise ValueError('Native GPU runtime disabled')
    if qualification_pilot is not True:
        raise ValueError('Explicit trusted qualification pilot required')
    if not isinstance(binding, NativeGpuBinding):
        raise ValueError('Trusted native binding required')
    gpu = profile.get('gpu') if isinstance(profile, Mapping) else None
    if (not isinstance(gpu, Mapping) or gpu.get('mode') != 'shared'
            or type(gpu.get('nominalMemoryGiB')) is not int
            or gpu['nominalMemoryGiB'] not in (5, 10, 20)
            or gpu.get('qualification') != {'mechanism': 'r615-native-cgroup-managed-deny',
                                           'status': 'pilot-unqualified'}):
        raise ValueError('Fixed unqualified native shared profile required')
    cap_mib = gpu['nominalMemoryGiB'] * 1024
    if (not isinstance(pod, Mapping) or set(pod) - {'apiVersion', 'kind', 'metadata', 'spec'}
            or pod.get('apiVersion') != 'v1' or pod.get('kind') != 'Pod'):
        raise ValueError('Kubernetes Pod document required')
    result = copy.deepcopy(dict(pod))
    metadata = result.get('metadata', {})
    if (not isinstance(metadata, Mapping) or set(metadata) - {'name', 'namespace', 'labels', 'annotations'}
            or metadata.get('name') != binding.name or metadata.get('namespace') != binding.namespace):
        raise ValueError('Pod name/namespace must match detached authority')
    annotations = metadata.get('annotations', {})
    if not isinstance(annotations, Mapping) or any(not isinstance(k, str) or not isinstance(v, str)
            or k.startswith(('cps.compute/native-', 'cdi.k8s.io/', 'gpu-', 'nvidia.com/', 'hami.io/'))
            for k, v in annotations.items()):
        raise ValueError('User reserved native, device or GPU annotations forbidden')
    spec = result.get('spec')
    allowed = {'containers', 'initContainers', 'volumes', 'securityContext', 'restartPolicy',
        'serviceAccountName', 'automountServiceAccountToken', 'nodeName', 'schedulerName',
        'priorityClassName', 'terminationGracePeriodSeconds', 'enableServiceLinks', 'dnsPolicy',
        'imagePullSecrets', 'shareProcessNamespace'}
    if (not isinstance(spec, Mapping) or set(spec) - allowed
            or spec.get('automountServiceAccountToken', False) is not False
            or spec.get('shareProcessNamespace', False) is not False
            or spec.get('nodeName', binding.node) != binding.node):
        raise ValueError('Unsafe Pod namespace, token, node or resource override forbidden')
    supplied_security = spec.get('securityContext', {})
    pod_security = {'runAsNonRoot': True, 'runAsUser': 1000, 'runAsGroup': 100,
                    'seccompProfile': {'type': 'RuntimeDefault'}}
    if not isinstance(supplied_security, Mapping) or any(k not in pod_security or v != pod_security[k]
            for k, v in supplied_security.items()):
        raise ValueError('Pod security override forbidden')
    volumes = {}
    input_volumes = spec.get('volumes', [])
    if not isinstance(input_volumes, list) or len(input_volumes) > 16:
        raise ValueError('Bounded explicit data volume list required')
    for volume in input_volumes:
        if not isinstance(volume, Mapping) or set(volume) != {'name', 'persistentVolumeClaim'}:
            raise ValueError('Only approved PVC data volumes permitted')
        _name(volume['name'])
        claim = volume['persistentVolumeClaim']
        if (volume['name'] in volumes or volume['name'] in _PRIVATE_VOLUMES
                or not isinstance(claim, Mapping) or set(claim) != {'claimName'}
                or claim['claimName'] not in settings.approved_pvc_claims):
            raise ValueError('Unapproved or reserved data volume forbidden')
        volumes[volume['name']] = copy.deepcopy(volume)
    containers = spec.get('containers')
    initializers = spec.get('initContainers', [])
    if (not isinstance(containers, list) or not containers or len(containers) > 8
            or not isinstance(initializers, list) or len(initializers) > 8):
        raise ValueError('Bounded explicit Pod containers required')
    user_containers = [_user_container(c, settings, volumes) for c in containers]
    user_init = [_user_container(c, settings, volumes) for c in initializers]
    # Rejected caller controls are replaced only after the trusted placement
    # binding is validated. Every GPU-capable user initializer remains behind
    # the CPU gate and belongs to the same capped Pod parent cgroup.
    for container in [*user_containers, *user_init]:
        container['env'] = [*container.get('env', []),
            {'name': 'NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', 'value': binding.gpu_uuid},
            {'name': 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', 'value': '0'}]
    names = [c['name'] for c in [*user_containers, *user_init]]
    if len(set(names)) != len(names):
        raise ValueError('Unique Pod container identifiers required')
    gate = {'name': GATE_NAME, 'image': settings.gate_image, 'imagePullPolicy': 'IfNotPresent',
        'command': ['python', '-m', 'cps_compute.native_gpu_runtime'],
        'args': ['wait-for-cap', '--namespace', binding.namespace, '--name', binding.name,
                 '--node', binding.node, '--node-uid', binding.node_uid, '--gpu-uuid', binding.gpu_uuid,
                 '--cap-mib', str(cap_mib), '--policy-hash', binding.policy_hash],
        'env': [{'name': 'NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', 'value': 'void'},
                {'name': 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', 'value': ''},
                {'name': 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'value': '1'},
                {'name': 'PYTHONNOUSERSITE', 'value': '1'},
                {'name': 'CPS_NATIVE_POD_UID', 'valueFrom': {'fieldRef': {'fieldPath': 'metadata.uid'}}},
                {'name': 'CPS_NATIVE_SPEC_SHA256', 'valueFrom': {'fieldRef': {
                    'fieldPath': "metadata.annotations['" + SPEC_ANNOTATION + "']"}}}],
        'securityContext': {**copy.deepcopy(_SECURITY), 'runAsNonRoot': False,
                            'runAsUser': 0, 'runAsGroup': 0},
        'resources': {'requests': {'cpu': '10m', 'memory': '32Mi'},
                      'limits': {'cpu': '100m', 'memory': '128Mi'}},
        'volumeMounts': [{'name': name, 'mountPath': target, 'readOnly': True}
                        for name, (_, target) in _PRIVATE_VOLUMES.items()]}
    spec.update({'containers': user_containers, 'initContainers': [gate, *user_init],
        'securityContext': pod_security, 'nodeName': binding.node,
        'automountServiceAccountToken': False, 'shareProcessNamespace': False,
        'enableServiceLinks': False, 'volumes': [*volumes.values(), *[
            {'name': name, 'hostPath': {'path': source, 'type': 'Directory'}}
            for name, (source, _) in _PRIVATE_VOLUMES.items()]]})
    digest = native_spec_sha256(result)
    metadata['annotations'] = {**annotations, SPEC_ANNOTATION: digest}
    return NativePodContract(result, binding, cap_mib, digest)


def validate_native_cap_receipt(receipt: Mapping[str, Any], expected_intent: Mapping[str, Any], *,
                                boot_id: str, pid_start_ticks: int,
                                driver_generation: str) -> None:
    """Verify the complete root seal and local first-gate lifetime before exit0."""
    _validate_intent(expected_intent)
    _uuid(boot_id)
    _uuid(driver_generation)
    _positive(pid_start_ticks)
    _closed(receipt, {'protocol', 'state', 'seal_id', 'intent', 'identity', 'readback'}, 'native seal')
    if receipt['protocol'] != PROTOCOL or receipt['state'] != 'sealed-before-user-init':
        raise ValueError('Native cap seal state/protocol mismatch')
    _uuid(receipt['seal_id'])
    _validate_intent(receipt['intent'])
    if dict(receipt['intent']) != dict(expected_intent):
        raise ValueError('Native cap intent mismatch')
    identity = receipt['identity']
    _closed(identity, _IDENTITY_KEYS, 'native identity')
    for key in ('pod_uid', 'spec_sha256', 'node_uid', 'gpu_uuid'):
        if identity[key] != expected_intent[key]:
            raise ValueError('Native cap identity mismatch')
    if (identity['boot_id'] != boot_id or identity['pid_start_ticks'] != pid_start_ticks
            or identity['driver_generation'] != driver_generation):
        raise ValueError('Native cap boot, gate lifetime or driver epoch changed')
    for key in ('host_pid', 'pid_start_ticks', 'cgroup_inode'):
        _positive(identity[key])
    if type(identity['cgroup_device']) is not int or identity['cgroup_device'] < 0:
        raise ValueError('Native cgroup device required')
    if not isinstance(identity['container_id'], str) or not re.fullmatch(r'(?:containerd://)?[0-9a-f]{64}', identity['container_id']):
        raise ValueError('Actual first-gate CRI container identifier required')
    _absolute(identity['cgroup_relative'])
    if identity['cgroup_relative'] == '/' or identity['cgroup_path'] != '/sys/fs/cgroup' + identity['cgroup_relative']:
        raise ValueError('Actual Pod parent cgroup path required')
    readback = receipt['readback']
    _closed(readback, {'soft', 'hard'}, 'native readback')
    expected_bytes = expected_intent['cap_mib'] * 1048576
    if any(type(readback[k]) is not int or readback[k] != expected_bytes for k in readback):
        raise ValueError('Exact native soft/hard readback required')


def _read_root_file(directory: str, filename: str) -> bytes:
    """Reject symlinks, permissive modes, nonroot owners and oversized records."""
    directory_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        if info.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o700:
            raise ValueError('Private root0700 authority directory required')
        file_fd = os.open(filename, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=directory_fd)
        try:
            info = os.fstat(file_fd)
            if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
                    or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600 or info.st_size > 16384):
                raise ValueError('Private root0600 bounded authority file required')
            data = os.read(file_fd, 16385)
            if len(data) > 16384:
                raise ValueError('Oversized native receipt')
            return data
        finally:
            os.close(file_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)


def validate_native_driver_health(directory: str = DRIVER_METADATA) -> None:
    """Corroborate the protected epoch with required R615/UVM kernel state."""
    root = Path(directory)
    expected = {'nvidia/version': '615.71.09',
        'nvidia_uvm/parameters/uvm_deny_managed_mmap': 'Y',
        'nvidia_uvm/parameters/uvm_disable_hmm': 'Y',
        'nvidia_uvm/parameters/uvm_ats_mode': '0',
        'nvidia_uvm/parameters/uvm_enable_builtin_tests': '0',
        'nvidia_uvm/parameters/uvm_disable_sam_migration': 'Y'}
    for name, value in expected.items():
        if (root / name).read_text().strip() != value:
            raise ValueError('Native GPU kernel guard/driver health mismatch: ' + name)


def wait_for_native_cap(intent: Mapping[str, Any], *, timeout_seconds: int = 300) -> None:
    """Root CPU gate only. Missing receipts wait; any invalid/stale seal fails."""
    _validate_intent(intent)
    if os.geteuid() != 0 or type(timeout_seconds) is not int or not 1 <= timeout_seconds <= 300:
        raise ValueError('Bounded trusted root cap gate required')
    boot_id = Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
    process_stat = Path('/proc/self/stat').read_text()
    pid_start_ticks = int(process_stat[process_stat.rfind(')') + 2:].split()[19])
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds
    while True:
        try:
            generation = _read_root_file(AUTHORITY, 'driver-generation').decode().strip()
            _uuid(generation)
            validate_native_driver_health()
            raw = _read_root_file(RECEIPTS, intent['pod_uid'] + '.json')
        except FileNotFoundError:
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError('Native cap receipt/driver epoch not available') from None
            time.sleep(0.1)
            continue
        validate_native_cap_receipt(json.loads(raw), intent, boot_id=boot_id,
                                   pid_start_ticks=pid_start_ticks, driver_generation=generation)
        # A concurrent maintenance invalidation must not release this gate.
        if _read_root_file(AUTHORITY, 'driver-generation').decode().strip() != generation:
            raise ValueError('Native driver epoch changed while validating seal')
        validate_native_driver_health()
        return


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='operation', required=True)
    gate = commands.add_parser('wait-for-cap')
    for flag in ('namespace', 'name', 'node', 'node-uid', 'gpu-uuid', 'policy-hash'):
        gate.add_argument('--' + flag, required=True)
    gate.add_argument('--cap-mib', type=int, required=True)
    gate.add_argument('--timeout-seconds', type=int, default=300)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    intent = {'namespace': args.namespace, 'name': args.name, 'node': args.node,
        'node_uid': args.node_uid, 'gpu_uuid': args.gpu_uuid, 'cap_mib': args.cap_mib,
        'policy_hash': args.policy_hash, 'pod_uid': os.environ.get('CPS_NATIVE_POD_UID'),
        'spec_sha256': os.environ.get('CPS_NATIVE_SPEC_SHA256')}
    wait_for_native_cap(intent, timeout_seconds=args.timeout_seconds)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Bounded trusted CUDA session checks; never changes driver or native caps."""
import argparse
import ctypes as C
import json
import os
import time

from cuda_probe import Cuda, require


def emit(value):
    print(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--gpu-uuid')
    parser.add_argument('--cap-mib', type=int, choices=(512, 5120))
    parser.add_argument('--mode', choices=('heartbeat', 'oom', 'managed'))
    parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=int, default=120)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.execute:
        emit({'state': 'inert', 'production_qualified': False})
        return
    require(args.gpu_uuid and args.cap_mib and args.mode, 'Exact trusted fixture arguments required')
    require(os.getuid() == 1000 and os.getgid() == 100 and not os.environ.get('LD_PRELOAD'),
            'Ordinary UID1000/GID100 without preload required')
    require(1 <= args.seconds <= 180, 'Bounded measurement interval required')
    driver = Cuda(args.gpu_uuid)
    try:
        info = driver.info()
        require(info['cuda_result'] == 0 and info['total_bytes'] == args.cap_mib * 1048576,
                'Actual process-visible native cap must match trusted fixture')
        driver.lib.cuDeviceGetAttribute.argtypes = [C.POINTER(C.c_int), C.c_int, C.c_int]
        attributes = {}
        for attribute in (88, 100):
            value = C.c_int()
            driver.check(driver.lib.cuDeviceGetAttribute(C.byref(value), attribute, driver.device))
            attributes[attribute] = value.value
        require(all(value == 0 for value in attributes.values()), 'Pageable/HMM access must be disabled')
        emit({'state': 'context-ready', 'pid': os.getpid(), 'mode': args.mode,
              'attributes': attributes, 'memory': info, 'observed_ns': time.time_ns()})
        if args.mode == 'heartbeat':
            deadline = time.monotonic() + args.seconds
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                tick = driver.tick()
                require(tick['cuda_result'] == 0, 'Peer CUDA heartbeat failed')
                emit({'state': 'peer-tick', 'tick': tick, 'observed_ns': time.time_ns()})
                time.sleep(0.2)
        elif args.mode == 'managed':
            result = driver.allocate(64, managed=True)
            emit({'state': 'managed-attempt', 'result': result, 'observed_ns': time.time_ns()})
            require(result['cuda_result'] != 0, 'Managed allocation escaped the guard')
            require(driver.tick()['cuda_result'] == 0, 'Ordinary CUDA failed after managed denial')
        else:
            first = driver.allocate(64)
            require(first['cuda_result'] == 0 and first['touch_result'] == 0, '64MiB ordinary allocation failed')
            driver.check(driver.free()['cuda_result'])
            pointer = C.c_ulonglong()
            code = driver.lib.cuMemAlloc_v2(C.byref(pointer), args.cap_mib * 1048576)
            # Unexpected success is released without mapping or touching the requested budget.
            if code == 0:
                driver.check(driver.lib.cuMemFree_v2(pointer))
            emit({'state': 'over-cap-attempt', 'cuda_result': code, 'observed_ns': time.time_ns()})
            require(code == 2, 'Only numeric CUDA OOM2 qualifies the over-cap attempt')
            recovery = driver.allocate(64)
            require(recovery['cuda_result'] == 0 and recovery['touch_result'] == 0,
                    '64MiB ordinary recovery failed')
            require(driver.tick()['cuda_result'] == 0, 'CUDA heartbeat failed after ordinary OOM')
        emit({'state': 'measurement-passed', 'mode': args.mode, 'observed_ns': time.time_ns(),
              'production_qualified': False})
    finally:
        driver.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
